language_unit_dispositions.reason: Nowadays + increasingly-important-role opener — classic L2 calque, high reuse value
Much-more-than + Rather pivot — contrast structure for gap identification
Purpose-of-this-paper template — standard MCM objective formula
Task-labeled method preview — mirrors competition structure
Indicator-then-algorithm with utilize — common method preview
Only-by inversion — 只有...才能 calque, key paper conclusion
With-the-development-of opener — 随着 calque, very high L2 signal
Some-reports vague citation — generic literature reference
Last-but-not-least cliche — AI avoids this, high authenticity signal
Bare assumption bullet — common across all types
Notation-table pointer. Its wording is a one-off locator for this paper symbol table, not a move that transfers.
This-shows-that interpretation connector — 这说明 calque
However absolute-vs-relative contrast with L2 emotion calque
In-a-gesture-to misuse — highest-value L2 error, AI never makes
Accords-with-actual-situation — 符合实际情况 calque
Of-great-significance — 具有重要意义 calque
Only-by inversion repeated (same pattern as LU-010)
As-can-be-seen-from figure reference with that-is explanation
Scientific-and-reasonable self-praise — 科学合理 calque
Weakness sentence tied to this paper eventsubtype field and this roster. The complaint does not generalize.
Bibliography entries. Citation list has no prose move to reuse.

organization_logic.macro_structure: 7 major sections spanning 23 prose pages + 4-page code appendix. Balanced: ~25% model building, ~20% evaluation, ~20% results/strategy, ~15% generalization, ~10% validation, ~10% intro/conclusion.
organization_logic.dominant_pattern: Linear build-up: foundation model -> parameters -> sub-structure -> evaluation -> strategy -> generalization
organization_logic.section_coupling: Strong sequential coupling: each section depends on previous. Generalization section weakly coupled (conceptual extension without data pipeline).
organization_logic.argument_quality: Good linear progression with clear model-to-insight chain. Generalization section weakens overall argument by overreaching without data.
human_organization_signals: Numbered steps in adversarial regression algorithm
Honest weaknesses section admitting real limitations

main_argument_chains.claim: Soccer team coordination can be modeled as an undirected weighted passing network whose structural properties capture teamwork quality.
support_steps: construct adjacency matrix from passing events
compute 6 network parameters (degree, density, diameter, clustering)
identify formations and dyadic/triadic subgroups via K-means
validate through multi-scale analysis (time, region, season)
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the network representation, the paper would lack structural indicators entirely, reducing the evaluation to classical football statistics only.

main_argument_chains.claim: Teamwork performance is best evaluated adversarially relative to opponent, not as absolute score.
support_steps: exhaustive weight search finds 20 feasible combinations
LowestError selection yields optimal weights with Distribution as most important
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the adversarial framing, the model would score teams independently and miss the competitive interaction that determines match outcomes.

main_argument_chains.claim: Strategy must adapt to opponent for team to maximize win probability.
support_steps: adversarial model shows absolute scores insufficient
three specific changes recommended for Huskies
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: Without the adversarial insight, recommendations would be static and fail against adaptive opponents.

warnings.warning: Weighted clustering coefficient formula complex; subscript notation dense but consistent with Barrat et al.
Similarity normalization denominator max(d) may refer to different distance measure than Euclidean used in K-means.
Leadership intensity formula is conceptual with no empirical validation; weights alpha/beta/gamma not estimated.
